risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail but uses promotional and forward-looking language around scalability, margins, carbon intensity, and future profitability. Material risks include facility delays, hydrogen-capacity constraints, dependence on additional financing, and a disputed contractor claim of at least $760.0 million, with $372.6 million accrued as of December 31, 2023.
